subtitle: Ipuzzle yokubeka izinkanyezi
short_description: Beka inkanyezi eyodwa emugqeni, ekholomini nasesifundeni ngasinye, ungathinti.
description:
Beka izinkanyezi egridini ukuze wonke umugqa, wonke ikholomu nesifunda ngasinye esimakiwe kube nenkanyezi eyodwa kuphela, futhi azikho izinkanyezi ezimbili ezithintanayo, ngisho nangokuchezuka.

Thepha isikwele ukuze ujikeleze phakathi kwenkanyezi, ichashaza nengenalutho; amachashaza yizinkomba zamasikwele osuwaphikile.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
